name: Jean Charles Samuelian
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Alan (French digital health insurer)
profile: Jean-Charles Samuelian-Werve co-founded Paris-based health insurer Alan in 2016 and has led it since. Alan sells digital-first health insurance and prevention services in France, Belgium, Spain and Canada; a €480M Series G valued it at about €5.5B. He is also an early backer and board member of Mistral AI.
interesting_fact: Alan's 2026 Series G raised €480M (~$550M) at a ~€5.5B valuation to expand into Canada's group-benefits market; the company reported >€800M ARR and >1.1M members.
deep_cut_fact: Before Alan he co-founded Expliseat, maker of the 'Titanium Seat' economy airline seat that cut seat weight by about two-thirds; it earned him the French Industry Medal and two Montgolfier prizes. He is also a Founders Pledge member.
notes: Also appears as Jean-Charles Samuelian-Werve. Alan press room is the best formal route; he speaks often at French tech events (VivaTech, Paris Fintech Forum).

name: Adrien Nussenbaum
current_role: Co-founder and Chairman of the Board, Mirakl (stepped back from co-CEO role in 2026)
profile: HEC Paris graduate and serial founder who co-founded Mirakl with Philippe Corrot in 2012; Mirakl's marketplace and dropship SaaS is used by retailers such as Best Buy, Carrefour and Galeries Lafayette and was valued around $3.5-4B. After leaving executive duties in 2026 he became Mirakl's chairman (announced 10 Nov 2026), focusing more on philanthropy and film production.
interesting_fact: Mirakl's Nov 2026 governance change named him Chairman and said he will devote more time to philanthropy and film production, while ex-Sitecore CEO Steve Tzikakis took over his co-CEO remit.
deep_cut_fact: Before Mirakl he founded All Instant, a New York instant-messaging platform sold in 2003, then with Corrot built SplitGames, a video-game marketplace sold to Fnac in 2008, after which the pair designed Fnac.com's marketplace - the blueprint for Mirakl.
notes: Now non-executive; film production and philanthropy are new interests - a possible angle. No published press email found on Mirakl newsroom; approach via Mirakl comms/newsroom or LinkedIn.
